authority: CBCC Phase 3 Opportunity-Family Evaluation consumer accounting

locked_behavior.pre_asset_rule: The locked opportunity-family universe is evaluated before mature asset architecture runs. Existing assets/files never determine whether a family silently exists or disappears.
locked_behavior.needed_rule: NEEDED requires an explicit WHY and at least one planned satisfying object/role before asset creation.
locked_behavior.not_needed_rule: NOT_NEEDED is a deliberate omission decision and requires both evaluation rationale and explicit why_not/omission_reason.
locked_behavior.missing_rule: A missing family decision remains visible as TO_VERIFY. MISSING_INPUT identifies the exact blocking input; neither state may be auto-promoted to NOT_NEEDED.
locked_behavior.no_quota_rule: The 23-family set is mandatory evaluation coverage, not a 23-asset quota. One object may satisfy multiple families and there is no one-family-one-asset requirement.
locked_behavior.activation_boundary: Platform capacity constrains activation/deployment, not the size of the opportunity universe.
locked_behavior.post_asset_rule: After mature asset architecture runs, fulfillment is audited against the predeclared NEEDED family satisfiers; missing active-family fulfillment stays TO_VERIFY without forcing unrelated extra assets.
locked_behavior.legacy_compatibility: The mature open-world asset universe, Creative Opportunity visual-mechanism engine and historical 12-axis post-asset family audit remain intact. Phase 3 does not replace or redefine them.
locked_behavior.matrix_rule: compiler.py writes artifacts/asset_universe_matrix.json before build_asset_architecture and finalizes the same artifact after build with opportunity_family_fulfillment and the existing open-world asset_universe.
locked_behavior.human_rule: The existing Commerce → Asset Universe workspace projects the same Phase 3 evaluation/fulfillment authority with family ID/name, decision, WHY, deliberate omission rationale, planned satisfiers and matched assets; it does not invent a second business payload.
locked_behavior.phase_boundary: Phase 4 Visual/Art Direction is not started by this closure. Full JSON→MD→HTML canonical parity remains Phase 6; fresh real K01 FULL remains Phase 10; built-plugin readback remains Phase 11; Provider actual-output QA remains E2E_PENDING.

verified_behavior: All 23 locked opportunity families are always present in the evaluation authority in stable order.
The absence of an authored decision leaves that family TO_VERIFY rather than hiding it or auto-marking it NOT_NEEDED.
NEEDED requires WHY plus at least one planned satisfying object; NOT_NEEDED requires a deliberate omission reason.
One planned object may satisfy multiple families, and the authority explicitly disables fixed per-family quotas and one-family-one-asset semantics.
The Phase 3 evaluation is injected before the mature asset architecture function executes.
Post-asset fulfillment audits NEEDED families against actual architecture objects and fails closed when planned satisfaction is absent.
The compiler materializes asset_universe_matrix.json before asset generation and finalizes the same artifact after architecture with fulfillment evidence.
The existing open-world asset-universe semantics and platform activation boundary remain intact.
The historical 12-axis post-asset family audit remains unchanged for compatibility.
The existing Commerce / Asset Universe Human Workspace exposes opportunity-family decisions, deliberate omissions and fulfillment from the same architecture authority.
Phase 2 Measurement behavior remains green in the fresh cross-scope regression batch.
Phase 4 Visual/Art Direction has not been started by this work.
